name: Ecommerce operations support: orders, returns & product listings (category)
summary: Behind-the-scenes work for online stores: processing orders, handling returns and shipping claims, and creating or updating product listings and feeds on Shopify, Amazon and other marketplaces.
whatYouDo: You upload and edit product listings (titles, photos, descriptions, prices), keep catalogues and marketplace feeds in sync, process daily orders through shipping tools, and log returns and damaged-shipment claims. Some roles add customer emails; senior roles add marketplace reporting, SEO and ERP or CRM integration.
appeal: Shopify and Amazon Seller Central skills are named as assets even in general admin postings
Clear progression: an experienced ecommerce operations role in London, ON paid $70,000–$90,000/yr (2026)
Can also be done as a freelancer for small online shops
watchOuts: Fully remote entry-level roles in Canada were scarce in searches; many are hybrid or in person (e.g. a $25/hr Vancouver contract required in-person shoots)
Canadian sellers also hire offshore assistants: one Canadian ecommerce company advertised a full-time remote assistant at $400–$550 USD/month (May 2025), which pushes freelance rates down
Jobs where you receive and reship parcels ('package inspector', 'quality control') are scams that can involve you in crime
'Product boosting' or task jobs that show earnings and then ask for crypto deposits are scams (CAFC warning)
Job Bank's e-commerce coordinator wages (median about $35.58/hr) describe a professional marketing occupation, not entry-level order processing

training.notes: Employers usually expect platform skills (Shopify admin, Amazon Seller Central, shipping software). No specific training route was checked.

compensation.notes: Employer-stated pay in two Indeed postings read 2026-10-13 that include ecommerce tasks: $19–$23/hr (remote part-time admin, Shopify or Amazon an asset) and $25/hr (hybrid Vancouver contract managing Shopify listings). An experienced in-person role in London, ON paid $70,000–$90,000/yr. Job Bank's e-commerce sales coordinator national median is $35.58/hr (range $20.50–$57.44; search summary).

reliability.notes: Employee roles are steady. Freelance listing and order work follows store seasons and client budgets.

applicationSteps: Learn one platform's basics (e.g. Shopify admin or Amazon Seller Central) and build a small sample catalogue
Search job boards for 'ecommerce coordinator', 'ecommerce assistant' or 'marketplace specialist' and check whether the role is really remote
Offer listing clean-up or order and returns admin to small online shops as a freelancer
Refuse any job that asks you to receive and reship parcels or to deposit money to unlock tasks
fitsIf: You like tidy data, online shopping systems and steady behind-the-scenes computer work.
notFitIf: You need a fully remote entry-level job right away or dislike repetitive detail work.

sources.title: Electronic Commerce (e-commerce) Sales Coordinator in Canada
sources.notes: Search-summary only. National range $20.50–$57.44/hr, median $35.58/hr (Ontario median $37.02). The summary placed it under NOC 11202, a professional marketing occupation; 2023–2024 data, updated 2025-11-19.

sources.title: Assistant to the Founder/CEO - Medole Inc. (Indeed)
sources.notes: Full posting read via the Indeed job API. Remote part-time admin and outreach role at a Canadian online health-products seller; coordinates sample shipments; Shopify and Amazon Seller Central experience an asset; $19–$23/hr.

sources.title: Social Media & E-Commerce Specialist (Contract) — Beauty Startup - Tsb Communications (Indeed)
sources.notes: Full posting read via the Indeed job API. Part-time contract, 3 days a week, hybrid in Vancouver (must attend in-person shoots). Shopify product listings, descriptions, promotions and basic site updates plus social media. $25/hr during a 3-month probation.

sources.title: E-Commerce Specialist - Express Employment Professionals (Indeed)
sources.notes: Full posting read via the Indeed job API. Recruiter posting for a London, ON client: in person, with WFH on Fridays. Maintain digital catalogues and product listings and run marketplace seller accounts. 3–5 years of experience; $70,000–$90,000/yr with benefits.

sources.title: Remote eCommerce Assistant – Shopify, Amazon, Walmart
sources.notes: Search-summary only (dated May 2025 in the summary). A Canadian ecommerce and logistics company hiring an offshore remote assistant for listings, daily orders (ShipStation or ClickShip) and returns, Mon–Fri on Eastern Time, at $400–$550 USD/month. Evidence of offshore price competition, not a route for Canadians.

sources.title: Reshipping Scams: How to Spot Fake 'Work-From-Home' Job Offers
sources.notes: Search-summary only; US/general, not Canada-specific. Fake 'operations coordinator', 'quality control' or 'product inspection' jobs have workers receive and forward goods bought with stolen cards, and workers can face legal trouble.

sources.title: Cryptocurrency scams offering fake jobs on the rise: Canadian Anti-Fraud Centre
sources.notes: Search-summary only (2023 coverage). The CAFC warns of fake freelance jobs 'boosting' apps or products: victims see small early payouts and are then pushed to deposit crypto they cannot withdraw.
